notes.title: Hotfix v0.3.0.2891
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where players can't save when creating a new game.

Fixed an issue where FPS dropped after playing for a while.

Fixed an issue where clients can't restock in multiplayer.

Fixed a bug where blueprint a Supply Portal would cause an error.

Fixed an issue where the Thermal Extractor couldn't be built in certain situations.

Blueprints can now correctly copy the everyday limit of the Supply Portal.

Blueprints can now correctly copy the filter settings of the Filter Splitter.

Automated Nurseries in Blueprints will now automatically remember and consume seeds.

Merchant items can now be purchased with high-tier currency with change included.

Optimized some factory inspection panels.

Athanor success rate is now applied and displayed correctly after upgrading Alchemy Skill.

Optimized NPC overhead info display.

Adjusted the material and color-change effect of the Storage Boxes.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2582
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where empty save slots couldn't be saved.

Fixed several issues related to the track system.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2570
notes.notes:
Improved save file loading speed

Fixed several issues that could cause crashes in multiplayer

Fixed an issue where the client’s inventory could be emptied after reconnecting

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2564
notes.notes:
Significantly reduced save file size.

Improved the lag issue when opening the load game panel with large save files.

Added mouse X/Y axis inversion.

Fixed a translation issue.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2556
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the house renovation tutorial video incorrectly played background music.

Added a conveyor input to the Iron Smelter.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2542
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where invisible cubes would remain after deleting a Wooden Shelf.

Fixed an issue where Catapults/Cannons failed to set targets when Large Storage Boxes contained items.

Updated the description related to research time.

Fixed several localization issues.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2530
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where Venus could not be restocked on the stand.

Fixed a bug where ongoing research would be stopped and not showing correctly after loading a save

Fixed a bug where the Alembic would not automatically stop when its output was full

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.0.2515
notes.notes:
Improved multiplayer experience by adding a data sync progress bar

Fixed an issue where items in the inventory were lost after loading a save

Fixed an issue where deleted buildings did not return materials after loading a save

Fixed a mismatch between displayed and actual required materials in the blueprint panel

Fixed an issue where deleting conveyor lifts would return extra materials

Fixed an issue where building blueprints in multiplayer caused conveyor belts to display incorrectly
